propositions: SupportsIncremental capability protocol has zero implementers and zero dispatch call sites in src/
SupportsIncremental docstring asserts incremental fetch behavior that is never invoked by core reconciler logic

Two test cases (test_backends_without_incremental_are_detected and test_dc_backend_is_deliberately_not_incremental) guard a capability that does not exist in practice and can be removed without coverage loss
ADR 0035 must be amended to reflect reduction from three opt-in capability protocols to two (SupportsLinks and SupportsComments only)
Removal is correctness-neutral and changes no observable reconciler behavior since full-scan fetch is the only active code path
